1.0.2.en: Fixed flow cards and pairing getting stuck after login

1.1.0.en: Migrated to ESM and Node 22, added all 13 supported languages

1.1.2.en: Fixed duplicate login/continue buttons during pairing

1.1.3.en: Fixed shared mowers not showing up during pairing

1.1.4.en: Added diagnostic logging for pairing issues

1.2.0.en: Added WiFi/Bluetooth/GPS/speed/time sensors, battery and GPS flow cards, and fixed shared mowers not reporting telemetry

1.2.1.en: Fixed MQTT connection dropping immediately and looping forever with no data

1.2.2.en: Fixed MQTT broker disconnecting due to unauthorized topic subscriptions

1.2.3.en: Added diagnostic logging for MQTT messages and sync requests

1.2.4.en: Fixed sync command using a wrong endpoint, and fixed telemetry not being decoded from the mower's MQTT messages

1.3.0.en: Rebuilt the device protocol on the real protobuf definitions so sensor values (battery, status, signal, GPS, area, progress) are read correctly

1.3.1.en: Added end-to-end diagnostic logging (cloud setup, MQTT credentials, applied telemetry) so a single submitted log pinpoints any failure

1.3.2.en: Reduced hub load (one-shot polling, only update on change) to fix sluggishness, and ignore an invalid progress value while the mower is idle

1.3.3.en: Fixed mowing speed, elapsed time and time remaining showing no data — area and progress fields are packed 16+16 values, not plain numbers

1.3.4.en: Fixed mowing speed and other zero-valued readings being silently dropped instead of reported as 0

1.4.0.en: Added a Repair flow to update your Mammotion account credentials without deleting the device, and clearer messages when login fails

1.5.0.en: Phase 4 BLE foundation: BluFi framing codec (unit-tested), BLE transport skeleton, and BLE sync command — ready to test on real hardware

1.6.0.en: Dual-mode transport: BLE preferred when in range, MQTT fallback; transport preference setting added to device settings

1.6.1.en: Added a Connection Type sensor (Bluetooth/Cloud) so you can see which transport is active, with full history in Insights

1.6.2.en: Added a diagnostic action to read the mower's stored mowing schedule (read-only — see docs/SCHEDULING_PLAN.md for why write support is deferred)

1.6.3.en: Fixed GitHub CI validation failure — added the required support URL

1.6.4.en: Fixed command routing for modern mowers (Luba 2 and later) — was incorrectly relying on the device display name instead of its product key, which could misroute start/stop/dock/pause commands

1.6.5.en: Fixed the app icon not showing on the Homey App Store — it had explicit pixel dimensions that broke the page's CSS mask

1.6.6.en: Quieted repeated Bluetooth 'device not found' log spam when using cloud-only mode — it's expected, not an error, and was flooding diagnostic reports

1.6.7.en: Fixed Bluetooth discovery never finding the mower — the scan was filtering by a service UUID the device doesn't advertise, even though it's there and connectable

1.6.8.en: Bluetooth reconnects now skip the full radio scan by reusing the mower's saved address — faster and less disruptive to other wireless devices on the hub

1.6.9.en: Bluetooth setup now fails fast (8s) instead of hanging for 30s when a weak-signal connection drops mid-setup, so it retries sooner

1.7.0.en: Improved Bluetooth reliability: service discovery now uses the full GATT scan instead of a filtered one (which was hanging), and retries back off from 15s to 4 min after repeated failures to reduce radio congestion

1.7.1.en: Fixed Connection Type sensor showing blank — it now initialises to Disconnected on startup and switches to Cloud as soon as the first telemetry arrives via MQTT, without waiting for a separate status message from the mower

1.8.0.en: Added Blade Speed control (Low / Medium / High) and Headlamp + Side LED toggles — all available as device controls and in Flow actions

1.9.0.en: Added RTK Position sensor (No Fix / GNSS / Float / RTK Fixed), Rain Protection toggle, Battery Cycles counter, and Blade Used Time — all from existing telemetry that was already being received but not displayed

2.0.0.en: Feature-complete release: full cloud control (start/stop/dock/pause, blade height and speed, headlamp, side LED, rain protection), full sensor set (battery, GPS, WiFi, Bluetooth, area, progress, speed, timing, RTK position, battery cycles, blade wear), and best-effort Bluetooth with automatic MQTT fallback

2.0.1.en: Fixed newly paired mowers missing several sensors and controls added in recent versions (blade speed, headlamp, side LED, rain protection, RTK position, battery cycles, blade wear). Completed translations for all 13 supported languages across every setting and Flow card.

2.0.2.en: Linked the Homey Community forum topic to the app's store page

2.1.0.en: Added a new step at the start of pairing that clearly explains how to set up a dedicated Mammotion account for Homey, so your regular Mammotion account is never logged out of the mobile app. Available in all 13 supported languages.

2.2.0.en: Added a dedicated Send to Dock button alongside the mowing toggle, and gave the mowing and blade height controls clearer titles on the device screen

2.2.1.en: Fixed the pairing account-setup screen showing a duplicate Continue button and an unreadable note box

2.2.2.en: Added custom icons for most sensors and controls, corrected the blade height range to match the real 25-70mm hardware limit, and fixed a broken icon reference

2.2.3.en: Fixed Bluetooth connection failures flooding the diagnostic log with errors forever on hubs/mowers where BLE never connects — after a few failed attempts it now retries much less often and stops logging them as errors, since cloud control keeps working regardless

2.2.4.en: Bluetooth being out of range is normal, not an error — connection retries no longer log as errors at all, just quietly less often over time, since cloud control isn't affected

2.2.5.en: Pairing now shows a helpful message when no mowers are found (check that the sharing invitation was accepted in the Mammotion app) instead of an empty list, and the mower driver got its own icon distinct from the app icon

2.2.6.en: The app icon is now the Mammotion brand logo, making the app easier to recognize in the App Store and on your Homey

2.2.7.en: Added a homepage link to the App Store page with feature overview and step-by-step account setup instructions

2.3.0.en: Added anonymous crash reporting so app crashes can be found and fixed proactively. Reports contain technical error details only — no account, location or personal data — and can be turned off in the new app settings page

2.3.1.en: Improved diagnostics for the 'no mowers found during pairing' issue some shared-account users are hitting, to help pinpoint whether it's a Mammotion account/sharing problem or a bug on our side

2.3.2.en: The App Store description now clearly explains upfront why you need a second Mammotion account for Homey, before you even start pairing

2.3.3.en: Fixed pairing finding no mowers on a shared account even after accepting the sharing invitation in the Mammotion app — the invitation now gets confirmed automatically during pairing, closing a gap the mobile app's accept button didn't always finish on its own

2.3.4.en: Fixed a header mismatch in the previous sharing-invitation fix that could prevent it from finding pending invitations at all, and added more detailed pairing diagnostics

2.3.5.en: Pairing now checks for mowers registered under Mammotion's older cloud system when none are found normally, and tells you clearly if that's the case — support for actually adding those mowers is still being worked on

2.4.0.en: Mowers registered under Mammotion's older cloud system can now be paired and controlled, not just detected — this is brand new and hasn't been tested on real hardware yet, so please report any issues; Bluetooth keeps working as a fallback regardless

2.4.1.en: Fixed the device not being marked unavailable in Homey when the mower itself reports being offline (e.g. powered off) — a command sent while the mower is off is no longer silently treated as successful

2.5.0.en: Added two new Flow triggers: Mower went offline and Mower came back online. Also made status checks back off automatically the longer a mower stays offline, instead of checking every 5 seconds indefinitely

2.5.1.en: Lowered how long offline status checks can back off to at most once a minute (was up to 5 minutes), so Homey notices your mower coming back online much sooner

2.5.2.en: Blade height now shows the value actually reported by the mower instead of only what was last set, so it stays accurate even if changed another way. Also added groundwork logging for headlight status ahead of adding it as a proper reading

2.5.3.en: Fixed a rare crash ('connack timeout') that could happen right as the app was reconnecting to the cloud, tearing the whole app down instead of just retrying

2.5.4.en: Added diagnostic logging to confirm mowers found via Mammotion's older cloud system actually reach the pairing screen, to help investigate reports of no devices showing up

2.5.5.en: Fixed the app getting stuck reconnecting to the cloud for several minutes with the same broken session after the Mammotion account's login token was invalidated early — it now logs in fresh instead of repeating the same failing attempt

2.5.6.en: Fixed a mower shared to your account only through Mammotion's older cloud system never showing up during pairing whenever that same account also had at least one normal mower — both are now listed together

2.5.7.en: Pairing now retries the older cloud system's device check once before giving up, to ride out occasional brief network hiccups reaching it instead of missing a shared mower for that one attempt

2.5.8.en: Added a diagnostic connectivity check during pairing to help pinpoint whether a household's own network can reach Mammotion's older cloud system at all, for cases where mowers still don't show up

2.5.9.en: The older cloud system's region lookup now falls back to a built-in country list if it can't be reached at all, instead of failing pairing outright — with logging for any country not yet in that list so it can be added

2.5.10.en: Fixed mowers added through Mammotion's older cloud system never receiving any data — the connection to that cloud's servers was missing a required security certificate and could never actually connect

2.5.11.en: Fixed mowers added through Mammotion's older cloud system still showing no data even with a healthy connection — the periodic request that asks the mower to report in was silently never being sent for these mowers

2.5.12.en: Fixed mowers added through Mammotion's older cloud system still showing no data — the periodic check that asks the mower to report in was never actually starting for these mowers in the first place

2.5.13.en: The older cloud system's login credentials are now reused and saved between checks instead of logging in fresh every time, with a short pause after repeated failures — reduces load on Mammotion's servers and avoids getting temporarily rate-limited

2.5.14.en: Fixed Blade Used Time showing a wildly overstated value (e.g. 3241 hours instead of the real ~54) — the mower reports this in seconds, not minutes, so the conversion to hours was off by a factor of 60

2.5.15.en: Fixed mowers added through Mammotion's older cloud system showing stale data even though they're online in the Mammotion app — once the periodic report request got rate-limited by the cloud, it kept retrying every 5 seconds forever instead of backing off, so it could never recover

2.5.16.en: Added a "Last Updated" sensor showing when data was last actually refreshed from the mower, so you can tell fresh data from stale data during a connection outage instead of assuming what's on screen is live

2.5.17.en: Fixed the new "Last Updated" sensor (and other recently added sensors) not appearing on mowers that were already paired before updating — Homey only adds new sensors to devices paired after the update, so existing devices now get them added automatically on the next app restart

2.5.18.en: The headlamp toggle and battery cycle count sensor are now hidden on mower models that don't actually have them (e.g. no headlamp on a standard Luba 2, no battery cycle count on models with a removable battery pack), instead of showing controls that never worked — applies automatically to already-paired mowers, no re-pairing needed

2.5.19.en: Fixed a Swedish spelling error on the blade used time sensor, and added a missing icon to the mower status sensor

2.5.20.en: Fixed the mower status never showing "charging"/docked and the "Mower docked" trigger never firing for some mowers — the docked state wasn't being read correctly for mowers that report it differently. Also added a new "Mower status changed" trigger card with the new status as a tag, for flows that want to react to any status change

2.5.21.en: Fixed the on/off status flickering rapidly during normal mowing (sometimes 20-30 times overnight) — many of the mower's own in-between states while returning to dock or briefly paused were being misread as fully idle/off instead of still working

2.5.22.en: Fixed Repair not actually recovering a mower stuck offline after repeated cloud errors — it now properly resets the connection instead of requiring a full app restart. Also fixed an error that could silently stop some sensor updates from arriving on models missing certain measurements (e.g. battery cycle count)

2.5.23.en: Fixed a burst of rapid, contradictory status updates after using Repair — it was starting a second, duplicate connection on top of the existing one instead of replacing it, doubling cloud traffic and Bluetooth scanning until the app was fully restarted

2.5.24.en: Fixed the mower status showing "paused" for a job that's actually paused while charging in the dock — it now correctly shows "charging" in that case, matching what the battery sensor already showed

2.5.25.en: Added diagnostic logging for a few previously-unread sensor fields (including one that may carry hardware fault codes like a lifted wheel) — no visible change yet, but helps identify the right data to build a proper error/warning sensor from real-world reports

2.5.26.en: The mower status and error alarm now correctly show "error" for a locked/faulted mower state that was previously shown as idle

2.5.27.en: Added two new sensors: Bumper Status (OK/Warning/Error) and Blade Active (on while the cutting blade is spinning) — applies automatically to already-paired mowers, no re-pairing needed
